facets.description: Office365 createEvent (lines 72-77) always uses destinationCalendar[0] and ignores credentialId, so other hosts' credentials post to the main host's calendar
Lark createEvent (line 128) has the same main-host-only destinationCalendar selection problem
CalDAV BaseCalendarService createEvent (line 156) has the same main-host-only destinationCalendar selection problem
